Location:
Zurich
Contract: 40%-60% with flexible duration (min 6 months) Rate: CHF 30/hour
Start: ASAP / by arrangement
Role Overview
As an AI Operations & Enablement Intern, you will play a central role in turning the AI tools and automations Rivero already relies on into shared, well-governed company infrastructure. Your work will span research, prototyping, and hands-on build-out, from evaluating an internal knowledge-management system to tracking automation usage and closing the feedback loop.
Key Responsibilities/Tasks
Research, prototype, and help select an internal "second brain" / knowledge-management system for the company
Help move automations and "skills" that today live on individual laptops and personal AI accounts into a shared, company-owned, version-controlled repository with a real handover process
Build lightweight usage monitoring across our automations, tracking which ones are active and how often they run, so we know what's working and what could be improved.
Design a feedback loop so any team can flag quality issues with an automation and get it routed to whoever owns it
Support a move toward provider-agnostic tooling, so our automations aren't locked into a single AI vendor
Get hands-on with further real-world use cases — e.g. compliance/contract-review support, HR onboarding automation, or customer-support and meeting-intelligence agents for our product teams
What We Are Looking For
You'll thrive in this role if:
You're currently studying Computer Science, Data/AI, or a related technical field (Bachelor's or Master's)
You're genuinely curious about and hands-on with modern AI tools — agents, coding assistants, automation frameworks. You follow the latest developments and AI usage patterns.
You have solid software fundamentals and you're comfortable with git; cloud knowledge is a plus.
You have a structured, process-oriented mindset; you'd rather build a system than ship a one-off script
You're comfortable taking a loosely-scoped, week-sized task and driving it yourself with minimal check-ins
You're fluent in English and based in or able to work from Zurich
What We Offer
CHF 30/hour, flexible around your semester schedule
Real ownership; your work becomes infrastructure the rest of the company relies on
Direct exposure to how a fast-moving fintech uses AI in production, across engineering, compliance, and operations
Mentorship from our engineering team
A possible path to a longer-term role
Additional Requirements:
This is a hybrid role based in Zurich.
Candidates must currently hold the right to live and work in the EU/EFTA area.

Send your CV and a short note about an AI tool, agent, or automation you've built or used and are proud of.
